invariants.rationale: The parameter config must be provided for the method to execute; typical defensive invariant.
The method switch-es on config.getIndexType(), which implies it's expected to be non-null.
One of either a non-empty index class or a valid index type is expected for proper execution.
If indexClass is null or not empty, or indexType is present, the method has a way forward.
The execution requires either a user-defined index class or a non-null index type to proceed.
